sections.title: Advncd Mthds Of Inq I
sections.description: This course develops students' capacity to reflect on their practice and growth as practitioners over the course of the program, examining their own development through the use of rubrics and reflective analysis to build a portfolio that outlines this growth and identifies a plan for continued growth in the future. Prerequisite: Enrollment in Independent School Teaching Residency Program.
